To address this, we developed SPACE MEMORY, an educational platform dedicated to preserving humanity's space, space exploration history, with a focus on abandoned space equipment and its legacy.

The platform brings together an interactive historical archive, scientific information and 3D exploration. Through historical mission records, interactive 3D models and comparison with authentic NASA photographs user can rediscover forgotten equipment, explore its history and understand its scientific contributions.

details:
SPACE MEMORY is an educational platform focused on preserving the history of abandoned space equipment and its scientific contribution. It combines an interactive historical archive, scientific information and 3D exploration, allowing users to discover forgotten missions, explore equipment models and compare them with authentic NASA photographs.

The platform helps students and the general public understand space history through engaging visual experience. Its goal is to preserve humanity's space exploration legacy, improve public awareness and inspire future generations.

Our team used google AI studio and digital design and 3D visualization tools to develop the platform focusing on historical accuracy, educational value, accessibility and ease of use.
